offer.text: You've become a friend to this village. Carry our banner well — bring 8 paper to seal the proclamation, and you'll be named among the honored.

accept.text: The scribes are waiting. Off you go.

decline.text: The honor will keep until you're ready.

in_progress.text: The proclamation still needs that paper.

ready.text: Paper at last. Let it be written.

complete.text: By the village's word, you are honored. Wear the name with pride.
